SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Koo Ts Nyi ( 顧子宜 )
native of Nanwei taken by me D.S.I. Golder
at Police H.Q. on the 21.8.40 translated Clerk Hsu Ta Yung
and interpreted by Clerk Hsu Ta Yung

My name is Koo Ts Nyi ( 顧子宜 ), age 34 native
of Nanwei, Pootung. I was graduate from the Kwang Hwa
University in 1928 and am at present a faculty member
of the following schools :-
1) Kwong Shih Middle School, 359 Connaught Rd.
2) Wei Ling Middle School, 336 Gordon Rd. and
3) Chuen Nyih Middle School, L.H. Tse Soh Building,
Nanking Rd.

Following the commencement of the summer vacation
in June, the students of the graduation class of the
Wei Ling Middle School have conducted supplementary
classes to the young members of the said school on the
premises of the Kwong Shih Middle School, aforesaid,
through my introduction, without requiring payment of
any rental. ( I have done so under the commital of
the young members - Junior 2nd - of the Wei Ling Middle
School). I did not know that the students of the
Wei Ling Middle School held a meeting of a political
nature in the Kwong Shih Middle School on 19.8.40
nor have I any knowledge that they intend fostering
anti-Wang Ching Wei sentiments among the students.

Signed : Koo Ts Nyi

Subject Assistance to Gordon Road Station in the matter of the arrest of
four middle school students.

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by D.S.I. Logan

At 5.50 p.m. August 19, 1940, a message was
received from Gordon Road through C.D.I. Kuh Pao Hwa,
Special Branch, to the effect that a number of middle
school students had been arrested following an
altercation with alleged agents of the Special Service
Section, No. 76 Jessfield Road.

Inquiries carried out at the request of the
station by the undersigned, D.S. McKeown, Clerk Chin
Ching Hai and C.D.C. 360 revealed the following :-

At approximately 4 p.m., students namely
YANG YING DONG (楊棠), YAO ZAO MING (饒召民),
HSU IH PING (許一冰), WONG YU SHU (王玉書) and
one other who did not attend the station, of the Wei
Ling Middle School situated at 336 Gordon Road had
just finished teaching the young members of the Kwang
Shih Middle School (光實中學) on the Kwang Shih
premises, 359 Connaught Road, and were holding a meeting
on the present political situation in China, their
political sympathies being with the Chungking Regime,
when they were interrupted by the intrusion of three
students of the Central University, (pro-Wang Ching Wei)
namely Pao You Wen (包有文), Yao Ding Liang (姚庭)
and Sz Wen Hai (施文海)

These three intruders, who besides being
students are members of the "Educational Section" of
the Intelligence Office, No. 81 Edinburgh Road,

unsuccessful. One Yang Ying Dong managed to make

vicinity. As a result four of the persons present
at the meeting were taken to Gordon Road Station by
the C.P.C., whilst the three members of the Central
University followed of the own volition.
        The four members of the Wei Ling School in
custody openly admitted that they were opposed to
the Nanking Regime and were holding a meeting to
foster anti-Wang sentiment among the students. On the
other hand the three members of the Central University
were not slow to admit that they were Wang's
adherents.

three Central University students that they were
visiting a friend one Chow Wei Shao (周滙滿) at the

meeting in progress. It is more than probable however

Regime had informed his friends in the Intelligence
Section.
